// Permissions - ask before destructive operations
  "permission": {
    "edit": "ask",
    "bash": {
      // Allow read-only operations
      "git status": "allow",
      "git diff": "allow",
      "git diff *": "allow",
      "git log": "allow",
      "git log *": "allow",
      "pnpm -w check": "allow",
      "pnpm --filter * check": "allow",
      "pnpm -F * check": "allow",
      "curl -s *": "allow",
      "ls": "allow",
      "ls *": "allow",
      "pwd": "allow",
      "cat *": "allow",
      
      // Ask for approval on destructive operations
      "git push": "ask",
      "git push *": "ask",
      "git commit": "ask",
      "git commit *": "ask",
      "rm *": "ask",
      "npm install": "ask",
      "npm install *": "ask",
      "pnpm install": "ask",
      "pnpm install *": "ask",
      
      // Deny dangerous operations
      "terraform *": "deny",
      "kubectl delete *": "deny",
      
      // Allow everything else
      "*": "allow"
    }
  },
